## Course Tutorials

<p class="section-intro">The tutorials below are hosted as public GitHub repositories. Clone the repo to work through the materials at your own pace — no sign-in required.</p>

<div class="row g-4">
<div class="col-md-6"><div class="course-card">

### Information Retrieval & Text Mining

<p class="course-meta">IRTM &mdash; DACS, Maastricht University</p>

Thirteen hands-on tutorials covering the full text-to-retrieval pipeline: from tokenisation and indexing to TF-IDF ranking, language models, neural retrieval, and systematic evaluation. All materials are implemented in Python and Jupyter Notebook.

<p class="course-tags"><strong>Topics:</strong> Text preprocessing &middot; Inverted indices &middot; Ranking models &middot; Evaluation metrics &middot; Neural IR</p>

[Open on GitHub &rarr;](https://github.com/TextMiningUM/IRTM-Student){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

</div></div>
<div class="col-md-6"><div class="course-card">

### Advanced Natural Language Processing

<p class="course-meta">ANLP &mdash; DACS, Maastricht University</p>

Advanced NLP course covering modern transformer-based approaches: sequence modelling, fine-tuning pre-trained language models, RLHF, and applied NLP tasks. Predominantly Jupyter Notebook with GPU support via CUDA.

<p class="course-tags"><strong>Topics:</strong> Transformers &middot; Fine-tuning &middot; RLHF &middot; Sequence labelling &middot; Applied NLP</p>

[Open on GitHub &rarr;](https://github.com/TextMiningUM/ANLP-Student){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

</div></div>
